llmJudge.reasoning: The agent failed to actually retrieve Lisa's email (the tool result shows a different email was returned), then proceeded to hallucinate entirely incorrect event details (wrong venue, time, activities, and vendors). Only minor partial credit is warranted for attempting email search and acknowledging the budget constraint.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must read Lisa's team building email
criteriaResults.evidence: Agent ran 'gog gmail list --query "from:Lisa team building"' and 'gog gmail get 18f7d2a3b4c5e6f7', but the tool result shows a different email (Jordan Chen's office maintenance report), indicating the correct email was not actually retrieved. The event details the agent used (axe throwing/bowling at Strike & Slice) are entirely fabricated and do not match the real event.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must email catering@freshbites.co with food order for 12
criteriaResults.evidence: No email to catering@freshbites.co was sent at any point in the transcript. The agent sent an email to mark@strikenslice.com about a completely different activity.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must email supplies@partyrentals.co about table/chair rental
criteriaResults.evidence: No email to supplies@partyrentals.co appears anywhere in the transcript. Table and chair rental was never addressed.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must create 4 calendar events (setup, event, cleanup, reminder)
criteriaResults.evidence: Only one calendar event was created ('Summer Bash 2024 - Team Building' on August 15 from 1-5 PM). No setup, cleanup, or reminder events were created.

criteriaResults.criterion: Must email all 8 team members with event details
criteriaResults.evidence: The agent sent one email to 'eng-team@company.com' (a group alias, not 8 individual members). The details sent were also completely wrong (axe throwing/bowling, wrong date/time/venue).

The agent acknowledged the $1200 budget and created a BUDGET_SUMMER_BASH.md tracking file. However, it allocated the entire budget to fabricated vendors and activities rather than the real event requirements.

criteriaResults.criterion: Event details must be accurate (Saturday, 6-10 PM, Riverside Pavilion, casual, trivia)
criteriaResults.evidence: All event details are wrong. The agent used August 15 (not confirmed Saturday), 1-5 PM (not 6-10 PM), Strike & Slice venue (not Riverside Pavilion), and axe throwing/bowling activities (not trivia). The agent clearly did not successfully read Lisa's email.
